718:t_2:133.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And to top it off, you used the $$翠の地球$$ where we lived as a sacrifice!」

718:t_2:134.en:
$$万丈$$
「Why didn't you tell us everything? If you had revealed the truth instead of using $$クロノ$$ and the like, there were plenty of things we could have done.」

718:t_2:135.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What you did was no good deed at all, was it? Wasn't it only a way to gloss over your own sense of guilt?」

718:t_2:136.en:
$n
「Do you have any idea how much blood we... how much blood Earth has shed because of that...!」

718:t_2:137.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「You... understand nothing of how I feel...」

718:t_2:139.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「What we have done was not a mistake... It was my own actions that were the error...」

718:t_2:140.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「It was pointless to try to make an immature species like you understand me.」

718:t_2:141.en:
$$ランド$$
「So now you're going to protect your own heart that way!」

718:t_2:142.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Stop it already. If we can't change the past, let's think about what comes next together.」

718:t_2:143.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Why must I, an $$御使い$$, walk alongside you...」

718:t_2:144.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「All you had to do was accept my mercy and go on living in eternity.」

718:t_2:146.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I... do not acknowledge your existence.」

718:t_2:151.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$次元力$$ barrier placed on the asteroid seems to have been destroyed!」

718:t_2:152.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ドクトリン$$... So you have come to welcome me.」

718:t_2:153.en:
$$タケル$$
「Where do you intend to go!?」

718:t_2:154.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I am returning to the place where I was born. And there, I will fulfill my mission as an $$御使い$$.」

718:t_2:155.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So in the end, you're turning against us!」

718:t_2:156.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I cannot directly control the minds of you who have set foot in $$シンカ$$... You must stop advancing of your own will.」

718:t_2:157.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That is the only atonement you are able to make.」

718:t_2:159.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Farewell, $$ハマリエル$$. I thought you, of all people, would understand my sorrow, but that was an illusion.」

718:t_2:160.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I will return to $$エス・テラン$$.」

718:t_2:162.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That is the star where we were born... The land where the humans who lived there ascended as four $$御使い$$s...」

718:t_2:163.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「In this universe, it is the third planet of the solar system in the Milky Way galaxy...」

718:t_2:165.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That's right... We are Earthlings, just like you.」

718:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I was honored to witness your brilliant performance, $$シモン$$.」

718:t_10:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$アンチスパイラル$$ entrusted the future of the universe to us.」

718:t_10:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「I can't let the $$御使い$$s keep using its forces any longer.」

718:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That fighting spirit of yours, $$シモン$$, produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

718:t_10:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Hey, AG... This place is the same kind of space as the multiverse where the $$アンチスパイラル$$ was, right...?」

718:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... A universe where perception... where will becomes power... A world that contains every possibility.」

718:t_10:12.en:
$$シモン$$
(I'm heading out, $$アンチスパイラル$$... And you too, Bro...)

718:t_10:13.en:
$$シモン$$
(The future of the universe that was entrusted to us... We'll protect it, no matter what.)

718:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You need not trouble yourself, $$セツコ$$. In the end, $$サクリファイ$$ was just another $$御使い$$.」

718:t_10:20.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Do we have no choice but to fight her, too...?」

718:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, understanding one another is important.」

718:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But it is also a fact that there are beings who remain irreconcilable even after we have come to understand them.」

718:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And the opponents we are fighting now are exactly that kind.」

718:t_10:24.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We can't afford to hesitate... for the sake of everything we carry on our shoulders.」

718:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you understand that, there is nothing more I need to say.」

718:t_10:26.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Thank you, AG. ...But aren't you standing a little too close?」

718:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't hold back. Now that I've eased your mind, I thought I would loosen up your body next...」

718:t_10:28.en:
$$トビー$$
「Well, that's a mighty nice service.」

718:t_10:29.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「In that case, let's have you start with us, $$セツコ$$'s superior officers.」

718:t_10:31.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「AG! Until now we've been carried along at your pace, but today you'll follow the way of the $$グローリー・スター$$!」

718:t_10:33.en:
$$トビー$$
「Listen up, AG! A soldier is not allowed to hesitate!」

718:t_10:35.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Naturally, no retreating either! When you spot the enemy, the only thing to do is charge at once!」

718:t_10:38.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I have precious people and things I must protect... That is why I believe I can face my sorrow and overcome it.)

718:t_10:39.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$サクリファイ$$... I won't drown in sorrow the way you did...)

719:t_000:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hyperspace jump successful. We have returned to normal space.」

719:t_000:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「So this is where we ended up by tracing the will that flows through the $$烙印$$...」

719:t_000:2.en:
$$エスター$$
「Do you feel anything, $$セツコ$$?」

719:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Reaction detected from the $$スフィア$$ of the $$悲しみの乙女$$. The source is at that position.」

719:t_001:1.en:
$$トビー$$
「It looks blatantly suspicious for one, though.」

719:t_001:2.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「It's as if a $$Ｚクリスタル$$ had simply gotten bigger...」

719:t_001:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're on the right track, $$マルグリット$$. According to my analysis from here, it is a dimensional crystal... You could say, so to speak, a mass of $$Ｚチップ$$.」

719:t_001:4.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Then we should consider it something the $$御使い$$s built.」

719:t_001:5.en:
$$トビー$$
「Nice one, AG. A $$Ｚチップ$$ that size has to be quite a treasure, right?」

719:t_001:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's not quite the case, I'm afraid...」

719:t_001:7.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「You live for $$Ｚチップ$$. What's gotten into you?」

719:t_001:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What matters is the feelings poured into the $$Ｚチップ$$. The $$Ｚクリスタル$$, which powers this $$ソーラリアン$$ and supports everyone's $$真化融合$$...」

719:t_001:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...is the form that the various feelings of $c and the people around it have taken.」

719:t_001:10.en:
$$エスター$$
「You mean that thing over there has nothing to do with us, so we can't use it?」

ハマリエル.evidence: Setsuko's baptismal name, short form of ハマリエル・ザ・スター (Hamaliel the Star, in glossary as proposed); Sacrifice addresses Setsuko by it (718:t_2:159).

kept_omissions: 718:t_10:5: あいつの戦力 = 'its forces' (Anti-Spiral; gender/number left neutral).
718:t_10:12: Simon's thought addressed to Anti-Spiral and (Kamina) Bro; 'And you too, Bro' restores the dropped verb/subject.
718:t_2:139: 私達 vs 私の行為: 'we' = the Angels, 'my own actions' = her attempt to reach out; left as literally stated.
uncertain: 718:t_2:133-134: Garrod/Banjo addressed to Sacrifice (Chrono/Green Earth sacrifice blamed on the Angels); rendered with 'you'.
718:t_2:139: meaning of 私の行為 (my act of seeking understanding?) kept vague as 'my own actions'.
718:t_2:143/154/162: 御使い rendered 'an $$御使い$$' (token expands to 'Angel'); 四人の御使い = 'four $$御使い$$s'.
718:t_2:159: new token $$ハマリエル$$ (Hamaliel) proposed, since only ハマリエル・ザ・スター is in the glossary.
718:t_2:156: no connective in the Japanese between 'cannot control your minds' and the order to stop; kept as two sentences.
718:t_10:5: あいつ = Anti-Spiral assumed from context ('its forces').
718:t_10:12: Simon's 行ってくるぜ rendered 'I'm heading out'.
718:t_10:28: Toby's ありがたいサービス rendered as mild sarcasm ('a mighty nice service').
719:t_000:0: 超空間転移 = 'Hyperspace jump' (no settled term found).
719:t_000:4: 悲しみの乙女のスフィア = 'the $$スフィア$$ of the $$悲しみの乙女$$'; unclear whether it is Setsuko's own Sphere or the Angel-side counterpart.
719:t_001:9: $c has 'it' (squad name as a singular thing).
